question: The mean of the first 15 natural numbers is:
solution:
The mean of the first 15 natural numbers is **8.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **The mean of the first 15 natural numbers:**

 
 
• The first 15 natural numbers are 1, 2, 3, ..., 15.
 
• The formula to find the mean (average) of the first n natural numbers is (n + 1) / 2.
 
• For n = 15, the mean is (15 + 1) / 2 = 16 / 2 = 8.
 
• Thus, the mean of the first 15 natural numbers is 8.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mean is 7.5:**

 
 
• This is incorrect. The mean of the first 15 natural numbers is calculated as (15 + 1) / 2 = 8, not 7.5.
 
 
 
• **Mean is 9.5:**
 
 
• This is incorrect. The mean of the first 15 natural numbers is 8, as derived from the formula (n + 1) / 2.
 
 
 
• **Mean is 9:**
 
 
• This is incorrect. Although close, it is not accurate. The correct calculation gives a mean of 8.
